principles: A family is justified by recurring line, form, value, highlight, color, surface, background, and detail behavior across materially different scenes.
Species, body build, pose, camera, relationship, season, temporary wetness, and one environment are not sufficient family evidence by themselves.
Scene-specific attributes are excluded from the family grammar and remain in scenes, modules, lighting, effects, or domain overlays.

deferred_candidates.label: Polished urban-apparel portrait cel
available_evidence: multiple fitted black T-shirt and tank-top upper-body portraits
multiple contemporary jacket, blazer, chain, and dog-tag portraits
multiple simplified station, nightlife, office, bedroom, and cafe support backgrounds
deferred_candidates.evidence_gap: The recurring line, value, highlight, and surface grammar remains materially identical to the existing polished soft-cel portrait family. Contemporary apparel and urban support backgrounds are reusable content layers, yet they do not establish two independent finish rules that separate a new family.
deferred_candidates.reconsideration_condition: Reconsider after at least three cross-scene references show a repeatable line, value, highlight, or background-rendering system that transfers beyond contemporary apparel content and remains visibly distinct from polished soft-cel portrait treatment.
